name: KCD Industries India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, KCD Industries Ltd is in the construction business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of real estate and constructions. It has also expanded into Décor, Infra, Printing, Hospitality and Auto mobiles sectors

pros: Stock is trading at 0.76 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.37% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 1,740 days.
Working capital days have increased from 1,966 days to 4,774 days
